title: Healthy Body, Healthy Mind
summary: In this lesson, you will learn useful words to talk about health and fitness. You will also practice using them in everyday conversations.

sections.p: When we want to stay strong and healthy, we need to move our bodies. Exercise is a great way to have fun and feel good. We use words like 'work out' to mean going to the gym or doing sports. Another good habit is to 'warm up' before we start so we do not hurt our muscles. Regular movement gives us more energy for our daily lives.

ex.en: I like to work out at the gym three times a week.
ex.mean: I exercise at the gym three times a week.

ex.en: Always warm up before you start running.
ex.mean: Do light stretches or movements before you run so you don't get hurt.

sections.p: Food is the fuel for our bodies. To stay healthy, we should try to eat a 'balanced diet' with lots of fresh vegetables and fruit. Drinking enough water every day is also very important. Sometimes, we want to eat 'junk food' like burgers or chocolate, but we should only eat those things sometimes, not every day.

ex.en: Eating a balanced diet helps you stay strong.
ex.mean: Eating the right mix of healthy foods keeps you strong.

ex.en: Try to drink plenty of water during the day.
ex.mean: Drink a lot of water throughout the day.

sections.p: Working hard is important, but rest is just as important for our health. If you feel tired, you need to 'get in shape' slowly and not push your body too hard. Getting a good night's sleep helps your muscles relax and gives your brain a break so you wake up feeling fresh and ready.

ex.en: You need to rest if your muscles feel sore.
ex.mean: You should take a break if your body hurts from exercise.

ex.en: Sleeping eight hours a night is good for your health.
ex.mean: Getting eight hours of sleep helps you stay healthy.

tip: Try to use one new fitness word every day when talking about your routine. Writing your goals in a notebook also helps you remember them better.

quiz.en: I like to ___ at the gym after I finish my work.
You should always ___ before you start running so you don't get hurt.
Eating fruit and vegetables is part of a healthy ___.
My legs feel very ___ today because I ran a long way yesterday.
Burgers and chips are often called ___ food.
Drinking enough water gives you more ___ during the day.
